feature.name: Contact Enquiry
feature.description: How a visitor reaches ALFEC: head-office contact details and map, and the enquiry form (identity, organization, location, activity, role, nature of works, message, one optional attachment, human check) that posts to contact/mail.php and ends on a translated confirmation. Server-side validation, upload limits and mail delivery are not visible from outside and are recorded as unknowns.

surfaces.name: Contact Section
surfaces.description: Panel 5 (Contact). Head office: 38, Rue El Moudjahid Kacha Lahouari, Cooperative Tekkouk Adda, Canastel 31000 Oran, Algeria. Tel. +213 (0)41 737 337 / 338, Fax +213 (0)41 737 339, Mobile +213 (0)555 071 930, contact@alfec.net (plain text, not links). Google map centred on 35.752182899, -0.563931 (zoom 16, scroll-wheel zoom off, marker "alfec"). Holds the enquiry form.

actions.name: Show Confirmation
actions.intent: Loading index.php with msg=success or msg=success_en opens the contact panel with the form replaced by the confirmation. FR: "Votre message a ete bien envoye. Nous vous repondrons des que possible." EN: "Your message has been sent. We will answer you as soon as possible."

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: msg query parameter of the landing URL.

rules.description: msg=success shows the French message whatever lg is.
msg=success_en shows the English message whatever lg is.

scenarios.name: English confirmation on a French page
scenarios.description: msg=success_en shows English even with lg=fr.

scenarios.name: French confirmation
scenarios.description: msg=success shows French.

actions.name: Call or e-mail in one tap
actions.intent: Phone numbers and the e-mail address become tel: and mailto: links.

evolution.rationale: On a phone, a visitor should reach ALFEC without copying numbers by hand.

transitions.label: Fill in the form
transitions.description: The form sits in the contact panel.

surfaces.name: Enquiry Form
surfaces.description: contact_form: multipart POST to contact/mail.php with identity, organization, location, activity, role, nature of works, contact numbers, e-mail, address, message, one optional attachment and a reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox.

stateDefinitions.description: Page language from the lg query parameter (shared name with Site Navigation & Language).
Activite select. "placeholder" is the first option (Activite / Activity), which has no value attribute and can be submitted.
Whether the free-text box for "Autre" activity is shown.
Text typed for "Autre" activity; it replaces the option value that gets submitted.
Vous etes ? select (Maitre d'oeuvre, Maitre d'ouvrage, societe generale de batiment, Collectivite Locale, Autre).
Whether the free-text box for "Autre" role is shown.
Nature des travaux select (Travaux Neufs, Maintenance, Autre).
Whether the free-text box for "Autre" works is shown.
The single optional attachment (field "piece"): any type, any size on the client side.
Whether the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox has been ticked.
Hidden form_canvas field: contact by default, set to contact_en only when the Envoyer/Send button is clicked on the English page.
editing: form shown; submitted: posted to contact/mail.php; confirmed: confirmation message displayed.
Language of the confirmation message, taken from msg.
What contact/mail.php reported. Only acceptance is observable from outside.

actions.intent: The "Piece jointe" button opens the file picker for one file. No accept filter and no client-side size limit. Tooltip: "Decrivez nous votre projet et vos besoins".

effects.description: One file attached (replaces any previous one).

actions.intent: Tick the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox rendered in #g-recaptcha-div1.

scenarios.name: Tick

actions.name: Send Enquiry
actions.intent: Envoyer/Send posts the form to contact/mail.php. The browser first enforces required fields and e-mail format; then the page checks the reCAPTCHA. Placeholder options pass the required check. The server response is not observable: only the success landing (msg=success / success_en) is known, and no error state exists.

parameters.name: pays
parameters.description: Pays select (French country names, default Algerie; optional).

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: How the submit was triggered: the Envoyer/Send button or the Enter key in a field.

rules.description: The button click sets form_canvas to contact_en on the English page.
The button click sets form_canvas to contact on the French page. Enter key skips both rules, so the English page submits contact (defect).

effect.description: Submission stopped until the reCAPTCHA is ticked.

rules.description: An unticked reCAPTCHA stops the submit with a French message, on both languages.

onBlockedEffects.description: Red French message above the captcha, on the English page too.

scenarios.description: Button on the English page posts contact_en.

scenarios.name: Enter key on the English page
scenarios.description: Enter skips the click handler, so contact is posted (defect preserved).

scenarios.name: Captcha not ticked
scenarios.description: Blocked with the French captcha message.

scenarios.name: Placeholder selects are accepted
scenarios.description: Submitting with Activite, Vous etes ? and Nature des travaux untouched still posts (defect preserved).

scenarios.name: Invalid e-mail
scenarios.description: The browser refuses a malformed e-mail.

scenarios.name: Missing message

actions.name: Tell the visitor when sending fails
actions.intent: Show a clear message in the visitor's language when the enquiry cannot be sent, and keep what they typed.

evolution.rationale: Today a failed send shows nothing, so the visitor thinks ALFEC received a request it never got.

actions.name: Check attachments on the server
actions.intent: Accept only expected document and image types within a size limit, verified on the server, with a safe stored name.

evolution.rationale: A malicious or oversized file should never reach ALFEC's inbox or server.

actions.name: Require a real choice in the menus
actions.intent: Activity, role and nature of works must be chosen, not left on their placeholder.

evolution.rationale: Enquiries currently arrive with Activite or Vous etes ? as the answer, which ALFEC cannot qualify.

transitions.label: Enquiry sent
transitions.description: Presumed redirect from contact/mail.php to msg=success / success_en (not observable without the source).

surfaces.name: Confirmation
surfaces.description: Contact panel after a send: the form is replaced by the message. Its language follows msg (success = French, success_en = English), independently of the page language (lg).

transitions.label: Contact details
transitions.description: Address, phones and map stay visible next to the confirmation.

dependencies.name: Enquiry Mail Endpoint
dependencies.description: Receives the multipart enquiry and sends it by e-mail. Validation, reCAPTCHA verification, upload limits, storage and recipient are not visible without the PHP source.

operations.name: sendEnquiry
operations.description: POST the enquiry and its attachment.
failureModes: server or mail failure (no error state reaches the visitor)

assumptions: On success the visitor lands on index.php?msg=success (FR) or msg=success_en (EN); inferred from the existing confirmation URLs, not observed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Head-office details and map stay published

acceptanceCriteria.then: the head-office address, the three phone numbers, fax, e-mail and a map of the head office are visible
acceptanceCriteria.description: Values are in the audit, section 7.

acceptanceCriteria.title: The enquiry collects the same information
acceptanceCriteria.given: the current field set (section 5 of the audit)
acceptanceCriteria.then: name, organization, city, country, activity, role, nature of works, phone, mobile, fax, e-mail, address, message, one attachment and a human check are still collected, including the Autre free text; removals need an explicit decision
acceptanceCriteria.description: Field names may change only together with the endpoint.
